name: OECD — Data Explorer SDMX REST API (sdmx.oecd.org)

rate_limit.source: OECD 'API best practices' explainer: rate limiting since November 2024; extracts read 2026-10-23 give 60 data downloads per hour, and a mirror gives 20 queries per minute and 20 downloads per hour. Self-imposed: the strictest, 20 per hour (one request every 180 s); traffic from VPNs or anonymisers is not allowed.

failure_behavior: 429 (temporarily blocked) or 5xx: bounded backoff, then the run fails; stored values keep their availability times. An empty OBS_VALUE is skipped with a reason, never zero.

datasets.description: Monthly CPI inflation, growth over 1 year, percent (OECD.SDD.TPS DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_ALL, key <AREA>.M.N.CPI.PA._T.N.GY) and monthly harmonised unemployment rate, percent of labour force, seasonally adjusted (OECD.SDD.TPS DSD_LFS@DF_IALFS_UNE_M, key <AREA>.UNE_LF_M.PT_LF_SUB._Z.Y._T.Y_GE15._Z.M)
datasets.coverage: US and the EU countries of config/markets/venues.json; India for CPI only (not in the OECD labour force dataflow)
datasets.history_depth: Monthly; request depth chosen per run
datasets.availability_rule: No vintages read: available from first-seen receipt time (flag available_from_first_capture); a changed value on re-fetch is a new publication at receipt time flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: OECD Terms and Conditions (read 2026-10-23 via search extracts; the page returns HTTP 403 to automated retrieval): where no specific terms or third-party interests apply, data may be reused for any purpose including commercial use provided the OECD is credited with the dataset citation; the APIs are free and subject to the T&C. Verdict: allowed for single-owner research with citation; cloud-model processing withheld until the owner decides.
datasets.rights_status: verified 2026-10-23 from search extracts of the official pages
